buzz.objective: Operate Buzz as a controlled, persistent, event-driven agent environment.
buzz.current_architecture: Buzz Desktop and relay for collaboration; OpenClaw for gateway, tasks, schedules, audit and model providers; Phase 1 observer adds deterministic event, policy, validation and state layers.
rationale: Reduce unnecessary model use and human intervention without weakening safeguards.
dependencies: Ollama or llama.cpp when local inference is needed
unresolved_issues: Secure automated publication of local briefs to the private Buzz channel is not yet enabled.
risks: Configuration drift between Buzz personas, team templates and managed runtimes.
next_actions: Prove Phase 1 reliability before enabling any A2 recovery action.

macmini-optimisation.objective: Improve the Mac Mini as a stable, observable and resource-aware AI automation host.
macmini-optimisation.current_architecture: macOS launchd hosts Buzz, OpenClaw, Ollama/llama.cpp, Tailscale and Home Assistant connectivity; Phase 1 is observe-only.
macmini-optimisation.current_status: Private Buzz operational channel created with the complete requested command team.
rationale: Observation must be reliable before reversible automation is considered.
unresolved_issues: Measure local model memory, latency and swap behaviour in Phase 2.

smart-home-control.objective: Maintain safe, deterministic Home Assistant-centred control.
smart-home-control.current_architecture: Home Assistant is the deterministic control plane; Buzz is the review and orchestration surface.
smart-home-control.current_status: Existing project retained; not modified by this Phase 1 build.

royal-navy-fleet-status.objective: Maintain the existing evidence-led fleet-status project.
royal-navy-fleet-status.current_architecture: Existing repository and Buzz workflow retained.
royal-navy-fleet-status.current_status: Registered for project-state continuity; not modified.

investing-agents.objective: Maintain existing investing-agent project state without granting autonomous trading authority.
investing-agents.current_architecture: Existing project retained; financial trading is A4 prohibited.
investing-agents.current_status: Registered for project-state continuity; not modified.
rationale: Financial actions require user authority outside this observer.
